Benthic macroinvertebrate metrics example data

Source: R/data.R
data_BMIMetrics.Rd

A dataset with example benthic macroinvertebrate (BMI) metric data for use with the getSiteInfo function.

data_BMIMetrics

Format

A data frame with 957 rows and 32 variables:

StationID_Master

a factor with levels

Year

a numeric vector

Index

a factor with levels Sp Su

BenSampID

a numeric vector

RepNum

a numeric vector

Lat_Dec

a numeric vector

Long_Dec

a numeric vector

InvertReg

a factor with levels cold warm

StreamType

a factor with levels Effluent Perennial

ActivityCategory

a factor with levels Field Replicate Routine Sample

BenCollDate

a factor with levels

NarRat

a factor with levels Inconclusive Meets Violates

IBI

a numeric vector

TotalTaxSPL_Sc

a numeric vector

DipTaxSPL_Sc

a numeric vector

IntolTaxSPL_Sc

a numeric vector

HBISPL_Sc

a numeric vector

PlecoPct_Sc

a numeric vector

ScrapPctSPL_Sc

a numeric vector

ScrapTaxSPL_Sc

a numeric vector

TrichTax_Sc

a numeric vector

EphemTax_Sc

a numeric vector

EphemPct_Sc

a numeric vector

Dom01PctSPL_Sc

a numeric vector

CollDate

a Date

BMISampID

a character vector

BMI.Metrics.SampID

a character vector

CSCI

a numeric vector

O_E

a character vector

MMI_Score

a numeric vector

ElevCategory

a character vector

Source

example data
